achievement_all_endings_single_desc: Discover every ending of a single story.
achievement_balanced_desc: Discover both a good and a bad ending of the same story.

achievement_dedication_desc: Spend more than ten minutes on a single playthrough.
achievement_first_ending_desc: Complete a story for the first time.

achievements_hidden_desc: Secret achievement — keep playing to reveal it.

ai_intro: Generate a unique interactive story, played right away. It is ephemeral, never saved, and achievements are not available for it.
ai_key_console_link: Create or manage your API key
ai_key_format_invalid: This is not an Anthropic key: it starts with sk-ant-. Check for a missing or extra character.
ai_key_help: Your key stays on this device and is sent directly to the Anthropic API. It never passes through any server.
ai_key_invalid: Invalid key or no available model.
ai_key_status_unchecked: Key not checked yet: press Validate.
ai_locked_hint: Enter a valid key to unlock the generation options.

ai_premise_placeholder: An idea, a place, a character... or leave empty for a surprise.

confirm_editor_leave_desc: Your unsaved changes to this story will be lost.
confirm_new_game_desc: Your progress in this story will be erased.
custom_delete_confirm_desc: Its save and discovered endings will be deleted too. This cannot be undone.
custom_empty: No custom story yet. Create one, copy a catalog story, or import a file.
custom_err_invalid_json: This file is not valid JSON: a comma, a quote or a brace is probably missing. Fix it in a text editor, or import a file exported from My stories.
custom_err_no_ending: The story has no reachable ending: link a scene with no choice (or marked as an ending) from the start scene.
custom_err_no_scene_ids: The story's scenes have no identifiers: give every scene an "id" field.
custom_err_no_scenes: The story contains no scenes: add at least one to its "scenes" list.
custom_err_not_found: This custom story no longer exists.
custom_err_not_object: This file does not contain a story: it should hold a single object with a title and scenes.
custom_err_quota: Browser storage is full. Delete a custom story and retry.
custom_err_too_large: This file is too large to be imported (1 MB at most): remove unused scenes, then retry.
custom_err_unknown: The operation failed. Please try again.
custom_intro: Create your own stories, copy the catalog ones, and share them as files. Everything stays private on this device, and achievements are not available for custom stories.
deeplink_err_unknown_story: The shared link points to a story that does not exist (anymore). Here is the full catalog.
deeplink_err_unknown_wiki: The shared link points to an encyclopedia entry that does not exist (anymore). Here is the main menu.
editor_choice_flags_help: Flags are free-form markers: a choice with a required flag only appears once another choice has set that flag earlier in the playthrough.
editor_choice_missing_target: This choice points to the missing scene "{target}". Pick another scene.
editor_draft_found: Unsaved changes from {date} were kept on this device.
editor_issue_broken_choice: Scene "{scene}": a choice points to the missing scene "{target}".
editor_issue_invalid_phosphor: The phosphor is unknown: it will be ignored, and the story will follow its genre.
editor_issue_no_ending: No ending is reachable from the start scene.
editor_scene_broken_title: A choice of this scene points to a missing scene.
editor_scene_delete_confirm_desc: Choices pointing to it will be removed.
editor_scene_id_err_format: Use only letters, digits, - and _ (no spaces).
editor_scene_id_err_taken: Another scene already uses this id.
editor_scene_id_help: Unique name of the scene, used by choices to point to it. Renaming it updates those choices.
editor_scene_orphan_title: This scene is unreachable from the start scene.
editor_unsaved_hint: Changes are only kept after saving.
ending_all_discovered: Every ending found ({found} / {total}). This story holds no more secrets.
ending_new_discovered_bad: New ending found: a tragic one ({found} / {total}).
ending_new_discovered_good: New ending found: a happy one ({found} / {total}).

help_editor_escape: [ESC] Leave the field, then the editor
help_howto_1: Pick a story in the catalog, read its info screen, then start it.
help_howto_2: At each choice, press its number or tap it. Choices are final: replay the story to explore the others.
help_howto_3: Progress is saved after every choice: leave whenever you like and resume later.
help_howto_4: Every ending found is kept. Under an ending, the path taken marks with ✧ the branches leading to endings not found yet.
help_menu_number: [1...9] Open a story by its number
help_wiki_back: [ESC] Back to the list, then to the menu
help_writing_1: A story is a set of scenes. The start scene opens it; a scene with no choice, or marked as an ending, closes it.
help_writing_2: Each choice leads to another scene. Its action and its consequence are printed when it is picked.
help_writing_3: Flags: a choice can set a flag, and another choice can require it to appear. Type the same name in both fields (suggestions list the flags already used).
menu_welcome: ↑↓ to choose, ENTER to read, ? for help.
menu_welcome_touch: Tap a story to see it, tap again to read. ? opens the help.
share_error: Could not generate the QR code.
share_progress_note: Heads-up: your progress is saved on this device only and won't follow you across devices.
share_qr_aria: QR code linking to this story
share_scan_hint: Scan this code to open the story on another device.
